summary: MZ73 job 1508 left the queue and the producer exited with code 1 after 268 ordinary MatRIS ML-NEB steps. Epoch 6 improved optimizer persistence and the minimum/final force relative to frozen-base job 1358, but the complete O-H path still folded and collapsed between images 05 and 06. The immediate hard stop was H50 moving 1.208728 A between images 04 and 05, just above the 1.2 A guard; the O-H backtrack was a strong warning but was not itself an automatic failure. No AQCat25 audit or downstream VASP/Dimer action occurred.

payload.objective: Obtain a separate user decision between exact-structure active-learning diagnosis of the new images 04-06 and a reviewed local VASP path-refinement route.
current_evidence: Job 1508 is no longer listed by squeue; final scheduler accounting is unavailable on MZ73, while the producer exit record reports code 1 at 2026-09-02T10:19:58Z.
The epoch-6 request/checkpoint binding remained exact through the failure record.
Ordinary ML-NEB reached step 268 without the 0.10 eV/A target; force maximum fell from 4.564192 to a minimum 0.166444 eV/A at step 228, then rose to 0.481108 eV/A.
The hard trigger was H50 moving 1.208728 A from image 04 to 05, exceeding the 1.2 A limit by 0.008728 A; image 05 to 06 was also 1.206354 A.
O-H distances fold in images 00-03 and jump from 2.062328 A at image 05 to 0.981520 A at image 06, leaving no internal image in the effective 1.08-1.82 A forming interval.
C1-C2, C2-O, C1-H48, adjacent RMSD, minimum pair distance, periodic branch, and both endpoint geometries pass their checks.
Compared with frozen-base job 1358, epoch 6 ran 268 versus 143 steps and improved minimum force from 0.220954 to 0.166444 eV/A, but did not remove the O-H path collapse.
AQCat25 fixed-path audit did not start because the primary MatRIS path never completed.
The failure does not by itself prove epoch-6 force error; exact-structure VASP comparison on the new failure structures is still absent.
payload.one_executable_step: Choose either to prepare exact MatRIS/AQCat25/VASP comparisons for returned images 04-06, or to prepare a reviewed VASP local micro-NEB reconstruction around images 05-06; no job is currently authorized.
payload.submission_boundary: Job-1508 authorization is consumed. Do not automatically retry, fine-tune, submit VASP, start Dimer, accept a TS, or report a barrier.
done_when: A downstream branch is explicitly selected.
Any selected structures and request hashes are reviewed before a new submission.
No failed GPU path is used as a Dimer parent or energy source.
